pairs: And I lifted up my eyes,
et in manu ejus funiculus mensorum.
and in his hand was a measuring line.
et videam quanta sit latitudo ejus,
so that I may see how great its width
and how great its length may be.”
Et ecce angelus qui loquebatur in me egrediebatur,
And behold, the angel, who had been speaking with me,
et angelus alius egrediebatur in occursum ejus:
departed, and another angel went out to meet him.
Jerusalem will be inhabited without walls,
præ multitudine hominum et jumentorum in medio ejus.
because of the multitude of men and beasts of burden in its midst.
And I will be to it,
a wall of fire all around.
et in gloria ero in medio ejus.
And in glory, I will be in its midst.
O flee from the land of the North,
quoniam in quatuor ventos cæli dispersi vos,
for I have scattered you into the four winds of heaven,
you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.
For thus says the Lord of hosts: After the glory,
Post gloriam misit me ad gentes quæ spoliaverunt vos:
he has sent me to the Gentiles, which have despoiled you.
touches the pupil of my eye.
quia ecce ego levo manum meam super eos,
For behold, I lift up my hand over them,
et erunt prædæ his qui serviebant sibi:
and they will be a prey to those who had served them.
et cognoscetis quia Dominus exercituum misit me.
And you will know that the Lord of hosts has sent me.
and I will dwell in your midst,
Et applicabuntur gentes multæ ad Dominum in die illa,
And many nations will be joined to the Lord in that day,
and they will be my people,
and I will dwell in your midst.
et scies quia Dominus exercituum misit me ad te.
And you will know that the Lord of hosts has sent me to you.
Et possidebit Dominus Judam partem suam in terra sanctificata,
And the Lord will possess his portion, Judah, in the sanctified land,
and still he will single out Jerusalem.
Sileat omnis caro a facie Domini,
Let all flesh be silent before the face of the Lord:
quia consurrexit de habitaculo sancto suo.
for he has arisen from his holy dwelling place.
